source: The certificate is not the one pinned for this account.
text: Chan e an teisteanas an tè a chaidh a phinnadh airson a' chunntais seo.
A bheil earbsa agad san teisteanas seo?
Cuir earbsa san teisteanas seo airson %1$s

source: On a connection that is not encrypted, LiveIMAP asks before sending the password. SCRAM and CRAM-MD5 do not ask.
text: Air ceangal nach eil air a chrioptachadh, bidh LiveIMAP a’ faighneachd mus cuir thu am facal-faire. Chan eil SCRAM agus CRAM-MD5 a’ faighneachd.

source: Send the password in the clear?
This connection is not encrypted. The password will be sent in the clear.
text: Chan eil an ceangal seo air a chrioptachadh. Thèid am facal-faire a chuir a-steach gu soilleir.
Cha deach am facal-faire a chuir.
Chan eil teisteanas air a phinnadh.

source: This connection uses STARTTLS. The password is sent after the certificate check.
text: Tha an ceangal seo a' cleachdadh STARTTLS. Thèid am facal-faire a chuir às deidh sgrùdadh an teisteanais.

source: This connection uses implicit TLS. The password is sent after the certificate check.
text: Tha an ceangal seo a' cleachdadh TLS so-thuigsinn. Thèid am facal-faire a chuir às deidh sgrùdadh an teisteanais.

source: Set a Sieve host, or turn on Same as inbound.
text: Suidhich aoigh Sieve, no tionndaidh air an aon rud ri teachd a-steach.

source: Warning: connects even when the server certificate fails validation (wrong name, expired, untrusted or changed), like pine /novalidate-cert. Anyone on the network path can then read your mail and password. Off by default.
text: Rabhadh: a’ ceangal fiù ‘s nuair a dh’ fhailicheas teisteanas an fhrithealaiche dearbhadh (ainm ceàrr, air tighinn gu crìch, gun earbsa no air atharrachadh), leithid pine /novalidate-cert. Faodaidh duine sam bith air slighe an lìonraidh am post agus am facal-faire agad a leughadh. Cuir dheth gu bunaiteach.

source: Allow old TLS and weak keys
text: Ceadaich seann TLS agus iuchraichean lag

source: Warning: allows TLS 1.0 and 1.1, small Diffie-Hellman keys and legacy ciphers for this account only. These can be broken; use only for an old server you cannot upgrade. Off by default.
text: Rabhadh: a’ ceadachadh TLS 1.0 agus 1.1, iuchraichean beaga Diffie-Hellman agus ciphers dìleab airson a’ chunntais seo a-mhàin. Faodar iad sin a bhriseadh; cleachd a-mhàin airson seann fhrithealaiche nach urrainn dhut àrdachadh. Cuir dheth gu bunaiteach.

source: Client certificate (IMAP and SMTP; SASL EXTERNAL when the server offers it)
text: Teisteanas teachdaiche (IMAP agus SMTP; SASL EXTERNAL nuair a bhios am frithealaiche ga thabhann)

source: Login method (blank = automatic; IMAP-LOGIN for the LOGIN command; PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256…)
text: Modh logadh a-steach (bàn = fèin-ghluasadach; IMAP-LOGIN airson an àithne LOGIN; PLAIN, LOGIN, CRAM-MD5, SCRAM-SHA-256…)
Chan eil an seòrsa ceangail a’ freagairt

source: This kind of file can run code or install an app. Open it only if you trust the sender.
text: Faodaidh an seòrsa faidhle seo còd a ruith no aplacaid a stàladh. Na fosgail e ach ma tha earbsa agad san neach a chuir e.

text: Tha teacsa a’ cheangail a’ sealltainn %1$s, ach tha an ceangal a’ dol gu %2$s.

source: This address uses non-Latin look-alike letters. Its real form is %1$s.
text: Bidh an seòladh seo a' cleachdadh litrichean nach eil coltach ri Laideann. Is e an fhìor chruth aige %1$s.

source: This is not a web or mail link. It opens another app, which may call, send a message or act for you. Open it only if you trust the sender.
text: Chan e ceangal lìn no post a tha seo. Bidh e a’ fosgladh aplacaid eile, a dh’ fhaodadh fios a chuir, teachdaireachd a chuir no gnìomh dhut. Na fosgail e ach ma tha earbsa agad san neach a chuir e.

source: Links of this type are blocked: they can reach files, other apps' data or run code.
text: Tha ceanglaichean den t-seòrsa seo air am bacadh: faodaidh iad faidhlichean a ruighinn, dàta aplacaidean eile no còd a ruith.

source: The server closed the connection when asked to push new mail (IDLE), which is a server problem. Checking for new mail every %1$d s instead.
text: Dhùin am frithealaiche an ceangal nuair a chaidh iarraidh air post ùr (IDLE) a phutadh, rud a tha na dhuilgheadas leis an fhrithealaiche. A’ sgrùdadh airson post ùr gach %1$d s na àite.

source: The server does not offer COMPRESS=DEFLATE.
text: Chan eil am frithealaiche a’ tabhann COMPRESS=DEFLATE.
